D: A Kansas farm girl is swept by a tornado to the land of Oz and follows the yellow brick road to the wizard.
P: Serve the snacks when Auntie Em hands out the fresh crullers on the farm.
S: Emerald City pea and mint soup
Bright green pea and mint soup with a swirl of cream

Soften the onion and garlic in the butter for 6 minutes. Add the stock and bring to the boil, then the peas, and simmer 4 minutes. Add most of the mint leaves and blend until smooth and very green. Season. Serve with a swirl of cream and the rest of the mint.
Twisted puff pastry straws with cheddar, parmesan and paprika

Heat the oven to 200C and line two trays. Brush one pastry sheet with egg, scatter with the cheeses and paprika, and lay the second sheet on top. Press down. Cut into 1.5cm strips and twist each one. Bake 12 to 14 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool on the trays.
M: Buttermilk soaked drumsticks in paprika flour, fried crisp, with mash
Chicken pieces soaked in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 170C until crisp, with mash and gravy.
Emerald City pesto penne with broccoli
Green pesto penne and broccoli, Emerald City style

Penne cooked with broccoli and peas in the same pot, tossed with basil pesto, parmesan and lemon until bright green. Cook 400g penne in salted water, adding 1 head broccoli in small florets and 1 cup frozen peas for the last 3 minutes. Drain, keeping a cup of the water. Toss with 190g basil pesto, the zest and juice of 1 lemon and 50g grated parmesan, adding pasta water until glossy. Toast 40g pine nuts in a dry pan. Serve topped with the pine nuts, extra parmesan and a handful of basil leaves.
W: Raspberry jelly in glasses. Tap your heels three times.
Raspberry jelly set in glasses with raspberries and a sparkle of edible glitter, topped with cream.
Twisted rings of choux, just fried, says Auntie Em
Choux dough piped into twisted rings, fried at 180C until golden, dipped in a honey glaze while warm.
Caramel apple wedges. Ask the angry tree first.

Crisp red apple wedges with a warm salted caramel dip, crushed roasted peanuts and a dusting of cinnamon for dunking. Melt 100g brown sugar with 60g butter, stirring for 2 minutes, then pour in 125ml cream and simmer 3 minutes until thick. Take off the heat and stir in half a teaspoon of salt. Cut 4 red apples into wedges and toss in lemon juice so they don't brown. Pour the warm caramel into a bowl, scatter with 60g crushed roasted peanuts and a pinch of cinnamon and serve with the apples.
Hard boiled sugar lollipops tinted in two colours
Homemade lollipops of sugar and glucose boiled to 150C, swirled with colours and set on sticks.
K: Lemon, pineapple and ginger. Follow the road.

Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup mixed with pineapple juice and grated ginger, topped with soda water over ice with a pineapple wedge. Simmer 80g caster sugar with 80ml water and 1 tsp grated ginger for 2 minutes, then cool and strain. Mix the syrup with the juice of 4 lemons and 400ml pineapple juice. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, divide the mix between them and top with 400ml soda water. Finish each with a fresh pineapple wedge on the rim.

dishes.n: Emerald City pea and mint soup
dishes.make_ahead: Make up to a day ahead and cool quickly to keep the colour; reheat gently

Add most of the mint leaves and blend until smooth and very green. Season.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 2 days ahead and keep in a tin

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C and line two trays.
Brush one pastry sheet with egg, scatter with the cheeses and paprika, and lay the second sheet on top. Press down.
Cut into 1.5cm strips and twist each one.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool on the trays.
Cut squares of baking paper and bring the water and butter to the boil.
Beat in the flour until a smooth ball forms, cool slightly, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Pipe twisted rings onto the paper squares.
Fry in oil at 180C, paper and all, until golden, peeling the paper off once they float.
Mix the icing sugar, honey and milk into a glaze and dip the warm crullers.
Line trays with baking paper.
Boil the sugar, glucose and water to 150C without stirring.
Split between two small pans, tint each a different colour with the food colouring and pour small rounds onto the paper, swirling the colours.
Press a stick into each and leave to harden.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak the drumsticks in the buttermilk overnight in the fridge, up to 1 day ahead; dredge and fry on the night

steps.text: Soak the drumsticks in buttermilk in the fridge overnight.
Rest the chicken in the buttermilk.
Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter.
Dredge the chicken in flour seasoned with paprika and salt.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 170C in batches until crisp and cooked through.
Simmer the stock with a little flour to make a gravy and serve with the mash.

veg.make_ahead: Soak the mushrooms in the buttermilk and salt up to 2 hours ahead in the fridge; dredge and fry on the night

steps.text: Soak the mushrooms in the buttermilk with a pinch of salt for 30 minutes.
Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter.
Dredge the mushrooms in the flour seasoned with paprika and salt, pressing it into the folds.
Fry in the oil at 170C in batches until deep golden and crisp.
Simmer the stock with a spoonful of the leftover flour to make a gravy and serve with the mash.

dishes.make_ahead: Make and chill the jellies up to 2 days ahead; whip the cream and add the glitter to serve

steps.text: Make up the jelly as the packet says.
Divide the raspberries between four glasses and pour the jelly over.
Chill until set.
Whip the cream, dust the jellies with glitter and top with cream.

veg.make_ahead: Set the jellies up to 2 days ahead, chilled; whip the cream and add the glitter to serve

steps.text: Whisk the agar and sugar into the juice in a saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Divide the raspberries between four glasses and pour the jelly over.
Chill until set.
Whip the cream, dust the jellies with glitter and top with cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Simmer, cool and strain the ginger syrup up to 3 days ahead in the fridge; juice the lemons and mix with soda water to serve

steps.text: Simmer the sugar, water and ginger for 2 minutes, then cool and strain.
Juice the lemons and mix with the syrup and pineapple juice.
Fill four tall glasses with ice, share the mix between them and top with soda water.
Finish each with a pineapple wedge on the rim.

w.how: Make up a packet of raspberry jelly and pour into glasses with a few raspberries in each. Chill for 3 hours until set. Dust with edible glitter so it sparkles like ruby slippers, then top with a little whipped cream.
